name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
summary: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver is a senior human wizard and a ruling member of Dalaran's Council of Six. Having survived the Scourge's destruction of Dalaran in the Third War, he oversees Kirin Tor operations from the Violet Citadel as Dalaran is rebuilt. Though dedicated to the rebuilding of his city, he also maintains discreet interests abroad—including keeping a watchful eye on his pirate daughter.

sections.title: A Pillar of the Kirin Tor
sections.body: A veteran mage who helped defend Dalaran across decades, Ansirem Runeweaver sits on the Council of Six, the ruling magocracy of the Kirin Tor. He survived the devastation when Arthas Menethil and the Scourge marched upon the city and Archimonde was summoned. In the wake of Dalaran's fall, Ansirem has aided the efforts to rebuild the arcane city, whose protective shield was lifted early, and now works from the Violet Citadel.

sections.title: Far-Flung Interests
sections.body: Despite his scholarly duties and stern wizardly demeanor, Ansirem possesses personal ties far beyond the Alterac Mountains. His rebellious daughter, Catelyn, spurned the arcane arts to sail as a swashbuckler with the Blackwater Raiders. Rather than disown her, Ansirem pays informants in Booty Bay—such as Baron Revilgaz—to send word of her exploits. He has also engaged in arcane studies involving troll antiquities and maintains diplomatic conduits across distant realms.

faq.answer: He is an accomplished human wizard and one of the six ruling archmages on the Kirin Tor's Council of Six. He has spent decades defending Dalaran and now oversees operations surrounding the reconstructed city and its arcane perimeter.

His daughter, Catelyn, grew bored of magical study and chose a life of piracy instead, sailing with the Blackwater Raiders in Stranglethorn Vale. Although Ansirem wishes she had chosen a more conventional career, he continues to support her from afar and pays contacts in Booty Bay to keep him updated on her safety.

faq.q: What is his role at Dalaran Crater?
faq.answer: Ansirem serves as a key Kirin Tor presence managing the perimeter of Dalaran in the Alterac Mountains, coordinating research, magical defense, and communication with allies while the city recovers from the destruction wrought during the Third War.

faq.q: Did Ansirem fight in the Third War?
faq.answer: He lived through it. When Arthas and the Scourge besieged Dalaran to enable Kel'Thuzad's summoning of Archimonde, Ansirem survived the city's destruction, though the details of his part in the battle are not recorded.

angles.text: Ansirem is a revered member of the Council of Six and the author of several core Kirin Tor texts, making him an enduring authority on disciplined arcane study.
As a Kirin Tor leader based in Lordaeron, Ansirem remains aligned with Alliance interests as human spellcasters struggle to reclaim their lands from Scourge remnants.
